description: Check the assistant's spending wallet on Base: address, whether spending is paused, NGT balance, per-request cap, session budget left, and about how many 0.001 NGT reference calls that balance covers. If USDC is on, also shows USDC balance, cap and budget left. Spends nothing. If no wallet is set up, explains how to set one up. Call this before the first paid request or a top-up.
name: ngt_wallet_status
title: NGT Wallet Status
